description: November 23 birthday meaning: Scorpio or Sagittarius cusp, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, November 23 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Scorpio or Sagittarius. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 23 birthday
paragraphs: Sagittarius season usually opens around November 23, though some years and birth times keep the Sun in late Scorpio. In most years it is at zero degrees of Sagittarius, in a first decan ruled twice by Jupiter. The birthday number 5 adds wanderlust and freedom, so the blend leans adventurous, with Scorpio-flavoured depth lingering beneath the openness.

By noon UTC on November 23, the Sun has normally reached roughly 0° of Sagittarius. That places the date in the Sagittarius decan that astrologers give to Jupiter, the first of three. Around November 21 to November 23, the Sun crosses from Scorpio into Sagittarius, from depth into distance. If you were born then, your Sun sign is settled by year, time and place, because the boundary shifts by roughly a day between years; a natal chart calculated for your birth is the reliable check. People who relate to both signs are often described as intense adventurers: they want to understand something fully and then go somewhere new with what they have learned. Honesty tends to be a shared value, sometimes delivered with considerable force.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 23 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 23rd, you have a compound of 2 + 3 = 5. The 2 brings sensitivity and the 3 brings expression, and the 5 that results is curious, social and quick on its feet. People born on the 23rd are often described as excellent communicators with a gift for reading people and a strong appetite for new experiences. Travel, languages and varied work tend to appeal. Among the day numbers, the 23 is traditionally seen as one of the most adaptable. Commitment can feel restrictive, so choosing carefully what to say yes to helps them keep their freedom meaningful.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 23 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 23 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 23 is the 327th day of the year (328th in a leap year). In most years Capricorn season is under way by December 22, 29 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 23 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 23 is also the birthday of Nicolás Maduro (1962), Miley Cyrus (1992) and Franklin Pierce (1804).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 23?
faq.answer: November 23 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Scorpio or Sagittarius on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Sagittarius. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 23?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 23 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 23rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 23?
faq.answer: By November 23 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 23?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 23 birthday are Nicolás Maduro (1962), Miley Cyrus (1992) and Franklin Pierce (1804). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
